remarks: OFFER DEADLINE - Tuesday, March 3 @5p. Welcome to 4 Union Ave #24, a spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath unit located in a well-run, centrally located Norwalk complex offering the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. This home checks nearly every box for today's buyer, featuring multi-level living, a convenient half bath on the main level, central air, and private in-unit laundry located on the top floor. One of just four units in the entire complex with a private deck, this home offers a rare outdoor retreat and is updated to move right into. The layout provides generous living space with excellent flow, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The complex offers ample parking in the rear, including two dedicated parking spaces for this unit, along with a community pool perfect for enjoying the warmer months. With no rental restrictions and only minimal breed restrictions for pets, this property offers flexibility for both homeowners and investors alike. Ideally situated near Union Square, you're within walking distance to great local restaurants, parks, and local amenities, with quick access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Metro-North train stations. Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in one of Norwalk's most convenient and desirable locations.
